place: 長安街沿線・天安門廣場

title.zh: 6月3日夜至4日清晨軍隊進駐與廣場清場，各方對傷亡記載不一
title.en: Night of 3–4 June: army advance, dawn evacuation from the Square, and differing casualty records

summary.zh: 1989 年 6 月 3 日夜至 4 日凌晨，戒嚴部隊從多方向強行推進並開火驅散沿途阻攔群眾（以木樨地、西長安街等路段傷亡尤重），隨後包圍天安門廣場；留守於人民英雄紀念碑旁的學生經與軍方接觸協商後，於 4 日清晨約五時前後列隊向東南撤離，部隊完成廣場清場。關於總體傷亡數字，不同公開來源差異極大：中國官方其後稱含軍警在內約 241 人死亡（部分說法近 300 人）；紅十字會初期估計、外交電報、記者與獨立學者的推估多在數百至數千人之間；「天安門母親」群體則長期核實並公布有名有姓的遇難者名錄與親屬證言（已核實逾二百人）。遊戲只並列不同公開記載，不擅作裁定，亦不為真實遇難者編寫對話。
summary.en: Through the night of 3–4 June 1989, martial-law troops forced their way toward central Beijing using live fire along routes such as Muxidi and West Chang'an Avenue before encircling Tiananmen Square. Around dawn on 4 June, after negotiations with military commanders, remaining students at the Monument filed out toward the southeast as troops cleared the Square. Public casualty counts diverge sharply: official PRC statements cited roughly 241 deaths (including military and police, or nearly 300 in some accounts); initial Red Cross reports, diplomatic cables, journalists, and historians estimate from several hundred to several thousand; and the Tiananmen Mothers have independently verified and published over 200 named victims and family testimonies. The game presents these documented discrepancies without fictionalizing real victims.
